title: Claude limit bachane ka slash advisor
content:
Claude ki limit hit na ho.
Iska sabse aasaan tareeka Claude Code ke andar hi bana hai.
Naam hai advisor.
Kaise kaam karta hai.

Ek sasta model saara kaam karta hai.
Jaise files ka naam badalna.
Docs padhna.
Tests chalana.
Woh Opus ko tabhi bulata hai, jab koi mushkil faisla aaye.
Jaise database kaise kaam kare.
Ya koi bahut zaroori email bhejni hai ya nahi.

Tab Opus manager ban kar kaam karta hai.
Intern ki tarah nahi.
Zaroori hisson pe Opus se best jawab milta hai.
Limit bahut der tak chalti hai.
Kyunki baaki models chalana sasta padta hai.

Bas Claude Code kholo.
Slash advisor type karo.
Aur Opus choose karo.
